integrity: Proof includes distinctness in the canonical projective quotient, tangent identities, exact Frobenius cycles and a reproducible symbolic and finite-field checker. Independent validation has not occurred.
limitations: Only the standard power-sum Bring curve for finite fields of characteristic at least 11; no assertion for twists, small characteristic, or the Hasse-Weil zeta function of the curve. Geometric tritangent coordinates and counts are classical; arithmetic novelty has residual priority risk.
title: Frobenius splitting of Bring's 120 tritangents and their contact points
